title: Stamp Album Missing Year Run
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stamp:item
| search missing_years=*
| stats sum(missing_years) as missing_years count as countries by album_name
| sort 0 - missing_years
value: Missing-year runs make it easier to choose a completion target that is coherent instead of random.
implementation: Send missing-year runs events to `index=personal` and keep `album_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of missing-year runs by albums.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which albumss stand out most for missing-year runs.
